item.description:
Aside 1.6.1

A stability release: two days of hunting down every bug we could find, about 85 fixes across the app.

Fixed

  • No more "Transcribing on-device…" forever. A rare deadlock could leave a finished meeting stuck on the transcribing step, taking the next meetings with it. Found, fixed, and covered by a test.
  • Call audio is captured more reliably. The recording path was rebuilt so heavy load can no longer cause dropped or garbled stretches — both sides of a call land cleanly in the note, verified on real calls.
  • Sync conflicts are visible now. If your vault and its git remote diverge, Aside tells you with a banner instead of silently retrying. Your local notes always win; nothing is merged destructively.
  • Notes survive the messy cases. Recovery after a crash, notes-only meetings, attachments, and unusual line endings all round-trip through the vault without losing content.
  • Cleaner transcripts. Stray transcription control tokens can no longer leak into a note, and speaker attribution got more careful about labeling someone "You" without evidence.
  • Dozens of smaller fixes across recording, transcription, the panel, and settings — the long tail of a two-day bug hunt.
